name: Kabyle

allophone_rules.notes: Spirantization of /b/ is blocked after a homorganic nasal /m/ (e.g., zembil 'basket' → [zəmbil], not *[zəmβil]). Kossmann & Stroomer (1997) p.469. Corroborated for Chemini Kabyle by Bedar, Quellec & Tifrit (2022): /nβ/ → [mb] and /mβ/ → [mb]. Native validation Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18: zembil pattern holds.
Spirantization of /d/ is blocked after /n/ (anda → [anda]). Kossmann & Stroomer (1997) p.469. Bedar et al. 2022: /nð/ → [nd].
Spirantization of /t/ is blocked after /n/ (anta → [anta], anteɣ). Kossmann & Stroomer 1997 p.469. Bedar et al. 2022: /nθ/ → [nt].
Spirantization of word-final /t/ is blocked after /l/ (tamellalt → [θaməllalt]). Bedar et al. 2022: /lθ,lð/ → [lt,ld] in Chemini.
Spirantization of /dˤ/ is blocked after /n/. Based on analogy; not covered by Bedar et al. 2022.
Spirantization of /d/ is blocked after /l/ (Ldi → [ldi]).

Validated native Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18: tasemmumt = [θasəmmumt] θ initial + t final after m, not [θasəmmumθ]. Chemini pattern per Bedar et al. 2022: /mθ/ → [mt]. Boghni/Makouda keep [mθ] – not followed here.
Validated native Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18: tamda = [θamda] θ initial + d after m, not [θamða]. Chemini pattern per Bedar et al. 2022: /mð/ → [md].

Validated native Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18: kra=ç, kečč=ç, kcem=ç, kteb=ç (spirantized initially), tilkit=k (l+k), amkan=k (m+k), k-ufiɣ=k (prefix keeps k), kullec=k (lexical), kem/kent=ç~k positional. Spirantization /k/→[ç] only post-vocalically or word-initially. Sonorant cases corroborated by Bedar et al. 2022: /ç/ occlusivizes to [k] after r,l,n,m.

Validated native Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18: argaz=[arɡaz] g after r, not [arʝaz]. /ɡ/→[ʝ] post-vocalically, word-initially, and after /m/ per Bedar et al. 2022: /mʝ/→[mʝ] before ə,i,a. Sonorant cases after r,l,n occlusivize; m does not.

Spirantization /k/→[ç] (Kossmann & Stroomer 1997 p.469; Karaoui et al. 2024 list [ç] in Kabyle inventory). Validated native Sétif: kra=ç, kečč=ç, kcem=ç, kteb=ç. Blocked after any consonant (KAB_BLOCK_SPIRANT_K_AFTER_CONSONANT). Geminate kk=/kː/ stays stop.
Spirantization /b/→[β]. Kossmann & Stroomer 1997 p.466, p.469. Geminate bb=/bː/ not targeted.
Spirantization /d/→[ð]. Kossmann & Stroomer 1997. adrar→[aðrar]. Geminate dd=/dː/ stays stop. Validated native Sétif: tamda=[θamda] shows blocking after m.
Spirantization /t/→[θ]. Kossmann & Stroomer 1997. Validated native Sétif: tamda=[θamda] θ initial, tasemmumt=[θasəmmumt] θ initial + t final.
Spirantization /ɡ/→[ʝ] post-vocalically, word-initially, and after /m/. Validated native Sétif: argaz=[arɡaz] shows occlusivization after r per Bedar et al. 2022. Geminate gg=/ɡː/ stays stop.
Spirantization /dˤ/→[ðˤ] (Kossmann & Stroomer 1997 p.468). Geminate ḍḍ=/dˤː/ stays stop.
Validated native Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18: tamɣart=ʁ, yemɣur=ʁ. /ɣ/ realized as uvular [ʁ] in all positions.
Geminate ɣɣ=/ɣː/ realized as long uvular [ʁː]; see KAB_GH_UVULAR_REALIZATION.
Vowel backing /a/→[ɑ] before emphatic and uvular.
Vowel backing /a/→[ɑ] after emphatic and uvular.
Default /a/→[æ] when not backed.
Vowel lowering /i/→[ɪ] in closed syllables.
Vowel lowering /u/→[ʊ] in closed syllables.
Nasal assimilation /n/→[ŋ] before dorsal. Bedar et al. 2022: /nç,nʝ/→[ŋk,ŋɡ]. Validated native Sétif: amkan=k with [ŋk] or [mk] assimilation, not palatal.
Nasal assimilation /n/→[m] before labial.

notes: Kabyle (Taqbaylit), Northern Berber. INPUT: Latin INALCO. Native validations Sétif-Lafayette 2026-09-18 for k/g/t/d/n: kra=ç, kečč=ç, kcem=ç, kteb=ç, kem=ç~k positional, kent=ç~k positional, k-ufiɣ=k, kullec=k, tilkit=k, fell-ak=ç, amkan=k, argaz=[arɡaz], tamɣart=ʁ, yemɣur=ʁ, tamda=[θamda], tasemmumt=[θasəmmumt]. Palatal [ɲ] removed - not attested intra-morphemically (afenjal, yenjer = [nʒ] not [ɲ]). Spirantization blocked after any consonant for /k/ in Chemini model (Bedar et al. 2022).

ancestors.notes: Immediate Glottolog subgroup (kaby1244): Afro-Asiatic > Berber > Kabyle-Atlas Berber > Kabyle. Traditionally within Northern Berber.
Arabic adstrate/superstrate: heavy lexical borrowing and the source of most of Kabyle's non-Proto-Berber emphatics and pharyngeals (ḥ /ħ/, ɛ /ʕ/, ṣ /sˤ/, ṭ /tˤ/), per Kossmann & Stroomer 1997 p.464.
